mission: At HTAFL, we unite children and young adults experiencing hate, oppression, depression, anxiety, and hopelessness through the transformative power of fashion and art. Our mission is to create safe, creative spaces where young people can express their authentic selves, build resilience, and discover healthier approaches to living. Through artistic expression and fashion-forward initiatives, we foster understanding, self-acceptance, and community connection. HTAFL empowers the next generation to transform personal struggles into creative strength, inspiring positive change and breaking cycles of negativity. We are committed to building a world where every young person can thrive free from hate, with confidence in their unique identity and creative potential.
creativeExpression: Through workshops and programs centered around art and fashion, we provide tools for young people to express their emotions and experiences in healthy, constructive ways.
fashionForward: Our fashion initiatives celebrate individuality while building technical skills, confidence, and community among youth faced with adversity and discrimination.
safeSpaces: We create environments where young people feel accepted, understood, and empowered to be their authentic selves without fear of judgment or rejection.
partner: Join us in our mission to transform lives through fashion and art. We're seeking partners who share our vision of creating a world where young people can thrive free from hate, with confidence in their unique identity and creative potential.
